cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?

mechanism: Copy a host's place-setting gesture without understanding the reason, then investigate a hidden dinner companion only through timing and transport clues.
confusable: Not simply asking who visited: A must avoid identity words and pursue the same missing person through circumstantial facts.
comparison: Dinner cleanup and a bus route, rather than tea and a book delivery.
seedUse: Retains kitchen timing/extra plate/bus inquiry; adds copied upside-down glass caused by a chip.
